separation_rules.hidden_geometry: Fully paint hidden/occluded regions needed for deformation.
separation_rules.lineart: Keep lineart separated from fill when deformation would otherwise distort edges.
separation_rules.shadows: Keep high-value facial/body shadows separable when they must follow deformation cleanly.
separation_rules.clipping: Prefer mask relationships over destructive flattening.
separation_rules.symmetry: Mirror only source art that is truly symmetric; preserve intentionally asymmetric details.
separation_rules.draw_order: Use explicit stable integer order in authoring files; do not infer order from filenames.
